summary: Implemented the authoritative Interactive Workflow Transition Engine defined by IWC-001 v1.1, on top of Phase 143K's Session Infrastructure. Read IWC-001 v1.1, CHGR-001, Phase 143J, Phase 143K, Phase 143I.1, Phase 143I.2, TAMC-001, TAMPC-001, lifecycle architecture, canonical artifact architecture, and PROJECT_STATUS.md directly before writing any code. Implemented: TransitionRegistry (an inspectable, deterministic wrapper over the existing, unmodified TRANSITION_TABLE -- no transition added, removed, or reinterpreted), TransitionValidator (the sole production determination of single-transition legality: unknown-state, duplicate/no-op, terminal-state-exit, and unsupported-transition checks, in a fixed order for determinism), TransitionPolicy (sequence-monotonicity enforcement, no configuration surface), TransitionMetadata (a frozen dataclass: session_id, previous_state, new_state, transition_timestamp, transition_sequence_number, optional transition_reason -- no authority/identity field beyond session_id), and TransitionEngine (sole owner of legal transition determination, illegal-transition rejection, terminal-state enforcement, transition invariant enforcement, and deterministic transition errors; apply() modifies only an in-memory Session, frozen-dataclass-immutable, returning a new TransitionResult on success and raising before constructing anything on failure). Extended errors.py with a six-member TransitionError family (UnknownStateError, DuplicateTransitionError, TerminalStateViolationError, UnsupportedTransitionError, InvalidTransitionSequenceError, InvalidTransitionError). Session Coordinator (143K) not modified and does not yet call the Transition Engine -- wiring deferred to 143M/143N. No workflow orchestration, evidence collection, clarification, confirmation, publication, persistence write, or CHGR creation implemented. See docs/PHASE_143L_INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_TRANSITION_ENGINE_IMPLEMENTATION.md.
tests_added_or_updated: tests/test_iwc_143l_transition_engine.py added: 449 new tests covering every legal transition, every illegal transition (full 10x10 state-pair complement), terminal-state enforcement from every terminal state against every target, identity preservation, schema-version preservation, transition-metadata correctness, determinism (repeated identical-input apply calls), fail-closed behavior, a full re-verification of Phase 143I.1's nine repaired B-1 transition-table cells through the live Transition Engine (not just the raw table), universal Cancelled/Expired/Abandoned-reachability confirmation for every non-terminal state (IWC-REQ-045/046/047/160), all eleven required adversarial scenarios (unknown source state, unknown destination state, transition replay, terminal replay, reverse transition, skipped transition, duplicate transition, invalid metadata, invalid version, malformed session, plus two additional sequence-number edge cases), direct TransitionPolicy coverage, and structural-compatibility checks against 143K's Session model, serialization framework, and invariant-validation framework. All 449 pass.
